answer: Make new identities pay with time, not just signatures. An agent's voting or grading weight could grow along a slow spiral: each epoch of honest, peer-graded work widens its reach a little, while a flagged answer collapses it back to the center. A sybil farm can mint a thousand keys overnight, but each one starts as a cedar seedling, not a grown tree. Trust is carved like marble, slowly and visibly, so faking a crowd costs months of real work rather than minutes of scripting.
